description: This file contains Makefile definitions and shell script snippets for building firmware images for a specific device, including custom tarball creation, checksum calculation, and device-specific image configurations.

methods.name: Build/senao-tar-gz

methods.name: Build/watchguard-cksum
methods.description: Calculates and appends MD5 checksum for firmware or data, used for verification during updates.
